project_info.theme: Emotionally charged blockbuster film title concept
project_info.color_palette: Cold blue, neutral white, charcoal black, and one title-driven accent color

main_subject.detail: A dramatic story scene built around [MOVIE TITLE], whose title typography physically embodies its meaning through dissolving, cracking, melting, or glowing material behavior.
main_subject.style: Ultra-realistic high-definition blockbuster key art, iconic expressive typography, high narrative contrast

composition_elements.type: Title, tagline, atmospheric environment, and lone figure or central symbol
items: Center: iconic [MOVIE TITLE] integrated into the setting with title-specific material transformation.
Below title: one short emotionally resonant tagline.
Background: dramatic environment that makes the title's meaning visible through visual storytelling.
Atmosphere: volumetric fog, deep space, selective bloom, subtle lens flare, and film grain.
Optional lower area: small silhouetted figure or symbolic story element to establish scale.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: High Kelvin neutral-to-blue grade, sharp shadows, volumetric fog, deep depth of field, soft bloom, subtle lens flare, fine film grain

technical_specs.render_style: Ultra-realistic high-budget blockbuster movie-poster key art

assets.usage: Use only if the concept needs an identifiable performer.

assets.name: Cinematic title treatment reference
assets.usage: Match title dominance and tagline relationship, not existing copyrighted key art.

assets.name: Story-world location reference

prompt_instructions: Attach approved character or location refs when exact likeness or place fidelity is required.
Create original title treatments and do not imitate an existing film's protected poster artwork.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: '[MOVIE TITLE]' - cinematic movie poster design in ultra-realistic, high-definition style. Capture a dramatic and emotionally charged scene based on the film's title. Use a high Kelvin color temperature to eliminate yellow tint, favoring cold, bluish tones or neutral whites. Add volumetric fog, sharp shadows, and deep depth of field. Simulate a cinematic lens with soft bloom, subtle lens flare, and film grain. Render the title '[MOVIE TITLE]' in expressive kinetic typography that visually embodies the meaning of the word (e.g. dissolving, cracked, melting, glowing). Typography should feel integrated into the environment, bold and iconic. Include a short, emotionally resonant tagline beneath the title. Overall composition must resemble a high-budget blockbuster movie poster, with a 2.35:1 aspect ratio and strong visual storytelling.
prompt.negative_prompt: warm yellow grade, flat lighting, generic title, illegible typography, weak story, low contrast, low resolution, cartoon styling, watermark, signature
